script_text: Feel the surge as Venus activates your relationship sector, Libra, sparking both romance and ambition. Mon-Wed, Venus in your 7th House trines Mars in Gemini and sextiles Jupiter in Aries, boosting charm and collaborative chances. Wed, Venus squares Pluto in Capricorn, warning against financial strain and power plays in love. Thu, Venus enters your 8th House conjunct the North Node, heralding a fated bond or shared investment. Thu-Sat, the Venus-North Node trine Saturn in Pisces steadies joint finances and encourages responsible commitments. Sun, Venus sextile Uranus in Taurus brings a surprise social invite or spontaneous treat that lifts your spirit. Tue is your power day - Venus sextile Jupiter in Aries magnifies luck in love and career networking. Wed is challenging - Venus square Pluto stirs jealousy and monetary tension; delay big decisions. Speak openly with a partner about shared goals to harness Venus's harmonizing influence. Follow for daily updates.
